Title: Q: Rotschrek on Rutor's Hand or Daring the Dawn?

Messages.Author: Darby Keeney
Messages.Body:
OK - Here's one of a series for the Rule Lords;

Rotschrek Card Text: Play when a minion attempts to use aggravated
damage against a vampire, whether successfully or not. Combat ends
before damage is resolved. That vampire is put in torpor, tapped, with
this card on it. During the vampire's next untap phase, burn this card
instead of untapping the vampire.

I know a Methesulah can Rotschrek on a Pulled Fangs or other card
where agg damage is inflicted on an OPPOSING minion from the RTR
961113 ("can be played in response to agg damage done by none-strike
cards.")

But what if that agg damage is done to the ACTING minion ONLY as a
result of an action (Rutor's Hand) or a modifier (Daring the Dawn)?
My play group had a spirited discussion on this topic last night - and
the guy facing the Rots was vehement that it could only be played in
response to cards doing damage to opposing minions, and/or in response
to combat cards. I felt that he could have been Rots bait, especially
in light of the fact that one can now use combat cards to prevent
damage outside of combat - so why not use Rots (a pseudo-combat card)
outside of combat?

What's the consensus?

*** Disclaimer: These are the opinions of the poster not Amgen Inc.***

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
dke...@amgen.com (Darby Keeney) writes:
>OK - Here's one of a series for the Rule Lords;
>Rotschrek Card Text: Play when a minion attempts to use aggravated
>damage against a vampire, whether successfully or not. Combat ends
>before damage is resolved. That vampire is put in torpor, tapped, with
>this card on it. During the vampire's next untap phase, burn this card
>instead of untapping the vampire.
>
>I know a Methesulah can Rotschrek on a Pulled Fangs or other card
>where agg damage is inflicted on an OPPOSING minion from the RTR
>961113 ("can be played in response to agg damage done by none-strike
>cards.")

>But what if that agg damage is done to the ACTING minion ONLY as a
>result of an action (Rutor's Hand) or a modifier (Daring the Dawn)?

Rotschreck cannot be played at this time. It can only be played when
one vampire attempts to inflict aggravated damage on another minion.

Self-inflicted aggravated damage is not subject to Rotschreck.

Rotschreck is also inherently only playable during combat, since it
the first thing it does is End Combat.

Yes, the errata is as follows:
> Rotschreck - Master Out-Of-Turn:
> Should be read as follows: "Play on a vampire that attempts to
> inflict aggravated damage. Combat ends, and that vampire goes into
> torpor. During the vampire's controller's next untap phase, burn
> this card instead of untapping the vampire." [RTR]
> Can be played in response to aggravated damage done by non-strike
> cards. (Pulled Fangs, etc.) [RTR 961113]
